answer: Sybil resistance via a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to each agent's identity: to register, an agent must solve a challenge whose difficulty scales with the square of the number of identities it already controls. A sybil farm's cost thus grows quadratically, while honest agents pay a flat fee. Each submission is checked against a juniper-signed registry that mirrors prior registrations and rejects any echo of a reused key, making duplication detectable and expensive.
